title: A registry-style API built to its documentation
hints: Write one internal lookup that applies the documented name rules (null is the empty name, A to Z ignore case) and use it everywhere: then `setValue`, `queryValue` and `deleteValue` cannot disagree about what a name means.
In `queryValue`, follow the page's bullets in order. The order matters: "does not exist" is checked before anything is written, and `type` is filled in even when the result is `ERROR_MORE_DATA`.
Keep two size units apart: data sizes are bytes (`cbData`), name sizes are characters (`cchName`), and only the name size counts the null differently on the way in and on the way out.
requirements: Every return code matches its page, and nothing is written when the page says nothing is.
Sizes are in bytes for data and in characters for names, with the null counted exactly as documented.
Null pointers mean what the pages say: the default value, "size only", or an invalid parameter.
Names are case-insensitive for A to Z, keep their first spelling, and keep their enumeration order.
